text:
maria: Kicking off ABI-stitch + quant 'GEMSWAP' rollout discussion for tonight's quiet window. Plan is small canary -> ramp. Need pins, rollback script, and release-note language.
jonathan: Packaging is done. prebake image gemswap:v3 pushed to staging. size delta +18MB.
qa_lee: Quick FYI: staging perf with long seq (16k) shows a ~2% p95 regression vs baseline on x86. Not a blocker but call it out.
ops_sam: Agree, suggest acceptance criteria: error rate <0.25% and p95 latency regression <10%. If either breaches for 3 consecutive 1m buckets, auto-stop roll.
maria: Good. Can we pin legacy-engine:v5 as a fast fallback? I'd like TTL 2h on the pin during the ramp.
deploybot: @maria pin request received. Applying sticky pin: legacy-engine:v5 -> project=redwood, scope=region:global, ttl=7200s. Pin id=pin-8192.
alice: I'll draft RN blurb: "experimental quant GEMSWAP (v3) — opt-in canary; fallback=legacy-engine:v5; metrics to watch: decode p95, model mismatch rate, memory OOMs." Anyone want different phrasing?
jonathan: Add note about connection-pool ABI change in the preface — there is a known socket reuse tweak that could affect long-lived connections.
qa_lee: Also add reproduction steps for qa: run load-tool with --seq 16k --clients 20 against canary slice. I'll run a smoke after deploy.
security-bot: Vault/KMS checks passed for gemswap:v3 image signature. No secrets exposure flags.
maria: Deploy timeline: 23:00 PT canary (0.5%), 23:15 -> 5%, 23:30 -> 25%, 00:00 -> 100% if green. Quiet window until 03:00.
ops_sam: I'll watch telemetry. I will escalate on pager if throttle or p95 > threshold.
deploybot: Starting canary rollout: slice=canary id=slice-20240313-1, bundle=gemswap:v3, initial-weight=0.5%.
jonathan: One more: we need to set kernel ABI compatibility flag to 'stitch-mode=relaxed' for canary nodes. Ops, can you flip?
ops_sam: Will flip to relaxed on the canary pool now. Command: `kctl set pool canary-stitch --flag stitch-mode=relaxed` — done.
qa_lee: Post-deploy smoke: two warmup runs passed, no OOMs. p95 +1.8% on sample, error rate 0.03%.
maria: That looks safe. Proceed to 5% at 23:15. Reminder to QA: run the long-seq workload at 23:20.
deploybot: Increasing weight: slice=slice-20240313-1 -> 5%. Change id=chg-441.
qa_lee: At 23:18 observed brief spike in socket resets on one AZ (us-west-2a). Seems transient; investigating with network team.
ops_sam: Added a temporary routing shim to divert new connections off that AZ. If spike repeats, we rollback.
maria: Rollback command for quick revert is: `deploybot rollback --slice slice-20240313-1 --to legacy-engine:v5 --force` — share if you need perms.
jonathan: small typo above — it's `jonathan` :)
jonathan: Re: rollback perms — ops and eng leads have sudo on deploybot. Confirmed.
alice: RN scrub done, pushed to docs repo with callouts and fallback steps.
security-bot: Post-change audit log entry created: audit_id=audit-20240313-gemswap.
maria: OK team — monitor for next 45m. If no regressions, I'll signoff at 00:15 and schedule grace unpin (ttl expiry). If we need to hold pins longer, we'll extend manually. Thanks all. :rocket:
